channel.title: Crochet and Yarn | OuqCreations
channel.description: Crochet and Yarn: cute, funny character stickers, shirts, mugs and gifts by OuqCreations.

item.title: Black Cat Crochet Here to Sit on Your Yarn
item.description: A smug black cat sits on a ball of yarn beside a crochet hook, proudly announcing it is here to sit on your yarn, just like every cat does. Perfect for crocheters and cat lovers, it makes a funny gift on stickers, mugs and tote bags. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.

item.title: Cute Crochet Ghost Haunted by Unfinished Projects
item.description: A little ghost floats along with a crochet hook and a half-made granny square, forever haunted by abandoned WIPs. A funny gift for crocheters and yarn lovers with a pile of unfinished projects, on stickers, sweatshirts and mugs. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.

item.title: Cute Yarn Snail Crocheting at My Own Pace
item.description: A cute snail with a yarn ball for a shell holds its crochet hook and happily works at its own slow pace. Perfect for crocheters and yarn lovers who take their time, it makes a funny gift on stickers, sweatshirts and mugs. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.

item.title: Proud Dachshund Yarn Chicken Champion Crochet
item.description: A proud dachshund holds up a tiny yarn ball down to its very last thread, the undisputed winner of a nail-biting game of yarn chicken. Perfect for crocheters, knitters and doxie lovers, it makes a funny gift on stickers, sweatshirts and mugs. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.

item.title: Smug Goose Not Hoarding Curating Yarn Stash
item.description: A smug white goose guards its pile of yarn balls with one wing, insisting it is not hoarding, just curating. Perfect for crocheters with an ever-growing yarn stash and a funny gift. Available on stickers, mugs and tote bags. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.

item.title: Crochet Possum Frogged It Again Feeling Great
item.description: A blank-staring possum clutches a tangled heap of unravelled yarn, frogged again and feeling great about it. A funny gift for crocheters and knitters who restart every project. Find it on stickers, mugs and tote bags. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.

item.title: Silly Goose Crochet Yarn Stash Is a Plan
item.description: A contented goose sits on a big pile of yarn balls and insists it's not a stash, it's a plan. It suits crocheters and knitters whose yarn collection keeps growing and makes a funny gift. Available on stickers, mugs and tote bags. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.
